title: AAPS 3.3.0: Main Menu Button CGM no longer visible/nor activates DiaKEM DEX G7 App (BYODA)
symptom: With AAPS 3.3.0, activating the CGM button in AAPS' config is still possible, but it does not show up on the main screen. Previously, pressing it brought the user straight to the DiaKEM Dexcom G7 App.
cause: The thread states 'Impossible for Android 11' as the reason for the issue.
fix: The issue was resolved in AAPS 3.3.1.1, as stated: 'Thanks for having realized this "Impossible for Android 11" and already closed issue with AAPS 3.3.1.1. -- works perfectly with Android 15'
evidence_quote: Thanks for having realized this "Impossible for Android 11" and already closed issue with AAPS 3.3.1.1. -- works perfectly with Android 15
